I opened #38272 that refactors Analysis/Normed/Operator/Mul by replacing ring_lmap_equiv_selfₗ and ring_lmap_equiv_self with a new toSpanSingletonₗᵢ : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] (𝕜 →L[𝕜] E).
The norm proof is now by simp (reusing norm_toSpanSingleton), and deprecated ring_lmap_equiv_selfₗ since it is just .symm toSpanSingletonLE
One remaining question: the reviewer pointed out that toSpanSingletonₗᵢ doesn't convey that it's an equivalence, but we couldn't settle on a better name. Any thoughts on what the name should be?
I say maybe toSpanSingletonLIE could be okay, since we have docs#ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingletonLE and docs#ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingletonCLE
